strings.name: Chuck Robbins
strings.summary: Chuck Robbins is an American executive who joined Cisco in 1997, became CEO in 2015 and chair in 2017. He has helped develop enterprise networking, security and software businesses. The Splunk acquisition and restructuring during his tenure affect teams, customers and employees.
strings.coverageNote: Reviewed through November 17, 2026. Director, CEO and chair tenures, acquisition completion and expected benefits, and fiscal and calendar years are distinguished. Birth year remains unconfirmed.
strings.influence.rationale: Contributed to Cisco’s networking equipment, security and subscription businesses, influencing commercial use of enterprise network infrastructure.
strings.facts.f1.label: Education
strings.facts.f1.value: Holds a bachelor’s degree in mathematics with a computer science concentration from UNC–Chapel Hill; honorary doctorates are not research doctorates.
strings.facts.f2.label: Career background
strings.facts.f2.value: Rose from sales and partner-organisation leadership to Cisco CEO; he is not a Cisco founder.
strings.highlights.h1.title: Networking and security businesses
strings.highlights.h1.text: Leads Cisco’s enterprise networking, security and software services; teams and partners contribute the technologies and products.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Transformation and workforce impact
strings.highlights.h2.text: The Splunk acquisition expands security and observability; the 2024 restructuring plan also affects jobs, so transformation is not presented solely as growth.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Reports first-quarter fiscal 2027 results
strings.timeline.t1.text: Comments on results for the quarter ended October 24, 2026 and AI infrastructure demand; full-year guidance remains a forecast.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Continues as Business Roundtable chair
strings.timeline.t2.text: The organisation publishes its 2026 leadership list and quotes him as chair; this is not recorded as his first day in the role.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Cisco announces restructuring plan
strings.timeline.t3.text: The company expects the plan to affect about 7% of its global workforce; this is the announced scope, not all layoffs completed that day.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Completes Splunk acquisition
strings.timeline.t4.text: Cisco announces completion, expanding security and observability capabilities; closing does not establish that all expected integration benefits have been realised.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Becomes chair as well
strings.timeline.t5.text: Elected chair while already CEO, separate from the 2015 CEO transition.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Takes over as Cisco CEO
strings.timeline.t6.text: The board appointed him on May 1 and elected him a director; the CEO role takes effect July 26. John Chambers remains chair.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Promoted to SVP, Worldwide Field Operations
strings.timeline.t7.text: Leads global sales and partner organisations, gaining operating experience before becoming CEO.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Joins Cisco
strings.timeline.t8.text: Enters the sales organisation, later leading US channel, Americas and worldwide operations.
